title: On the Convergence and Straightness of Rectified Flow
tldr_zh: W2² 离散误差 ≤ C·γ_{2,T}/T²；1-RF 直的充分条件（Jacobian 半正定）与 Monge 最优条件（Jacobian 可交换）
tldr_en: Piecewise straightness gamma_{2,T} bounds Euler W2 error as O(gamma/T^2); sufficient Jacobian conditions make 1-RF straight or even the Monge map.
key_numbers: GMM with max mean separation D: gamma_{2,T} = O(D^2 d^2 + D^4 d), independent of K (Lemma 2)
1-RF straight if max_{i!=j} ||mu_i - mu_j||^2 <= 4 sigma^2 for isotropic GMM target (Thm 7)
Gaussian->Gaussian: 1-RF gives Z1 = Sigma^{1/2} Z0 + mu, the Monge map (Thm 3)
Oscillating path S(Z)=O(N^-2)->0 while gamma_1 = 2e4 pi^4 (Sec. 3)
CelebA subsets: W2^2 error stabilizes near T~8, increases with modal complexity (App. A.3, Fig. 7)
